name: Dr. Ananya Roy
review: Standing at Laitlum Canyons at 6 AM with fog rolling beneath our feet was a spiritual experience. Escape to Meghalaya took us to secret viewpoints far away from tourist buses.

name: Marcus & Elena Vance
review: The Dawki river boat ride felt completely surreal! Our local guide Bah Wan shared Khasi folktales that made every valley come alive. Flawless luxury execution.

name: Vikramaditya Sharma
review: I came stressed from a 70-hour work week and left utterly transformed. Swimming in Krang Suri's blue pool restored my soul. Best travel service I've experienced in Asia.

name: Sophie Dubois
review: Fascinating community-based tourism! Seeing how Khasi tribes mold living fig roots across streams without hurting trees inspired my work tremendously.

name: Karan & Tanya Singhania
review: Private glamping under the star-lit Cherrapunji sky with warm Khasi meals served by candle light... It exceeded every expectation we had.

name: Rachel Chen
review: The monsoon in Cherrapunji is magic. Watching 100 waterfalls roar down green cliffs while staying in a heated glass suite was pure poetry.

name: Aditya Kulkarni
review: The attention to sustainable travel details, authentic bamboo homestays, and zero single-use plastics blew me away. Truly responsible tourism.

name: Nisha & Siddharth Mehta
review: Cliff jumping at Shnongpdeng and exploring ancient limestone caves in Jaintia hills gave us the adrenaline rush of a lifetime!

name: David O'Connor
review: As a filmmaker, logistics are paramount. Escape to Meghalaya handled every permit, local liaison, and terrain challenge effortlessly.

name: Pooja Hegde
review: Mawphlang Sacred Grove was the quietest, most peaceful place I have ever stepped into. The team curated mindfulness moments seamlessly.

name: Rohan & Priyamvada
review: From Guwahati airport pickup to our final flight home, everything was smooth as silk. Highly recommended if you want peace of mind.

name: Hannah Lindqvist
review: Felt 100% safe as a solo female traveler. Made lifelong friends and shared tea with village headmen in Mawlynnong.

name: Gautam & Sunita Nair
review: They tailored the pace perfectly for senior citizens without compromising on seeing Nohkalikai and Dawki's splendor. Very patient team.

name: Zubair Al-Mansoor
review: World-class hospitality nestled in raw nature. The team's knowledge of private trails in Meghalaya is unmatched.

name: Rhea Chakraborty
review: Every spot looked better in real life than on Instagram! Escape to Meghalaya is the real deal.
